accepted_scope_caveats.label: Theorems 8–9
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Efficient estimation and simultaneous inference are conditional on the explicitly displayed coherent-fit conditions RΣ=oP(1) and Δn=oP(n^-1/2); attaining these rates is deferred to Open-ended Question 2.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Root-n efficiency, covariance consistency, and maximum-t coverage hold under the displayed coherent-nuisance product-rate conditions.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper gives a binary hidden-treatment tangent-space/orthocomplement characterization; for continuous Y it states that closed-form optimal weights and EIF are generally unavailable and constructs an equal-width partition approximation.
Appendix A.8 extends the hidden-action construction to categorical actions, defines inverse conditional-moment features, their product representations, and a valid influence function.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Make Theorem 4B a sharper comparator theorem by proving a computable finite-sample or explicit lower bound on the partition inefficiency gap for a named binary subclass, not only PSD ordering and asymptotic convergence.

Promote the constant-X derivative inverse to a quantitative theorem with an explicit conditioning bound in terms of the three singular-value margins; this would make the DQM-lifting route substantially more falsifiable.

State a concrete low-dimensional implementation corollary for the K=3 witness that calculates the Gram solve and strict-gain diagnostic exactly, rather than leaving its numerical evidence only in technical limitations.

recommended_next_step: Advance to Stage 0, preserving the conditional-rate scope for inference and prioritizing the constant-X differential-inverse kill test before developing the full tangent-completeness proof.
